rubric_items.reason: Built only on existing repo, service, router, types, page and rupees helper; no new endpoint, table or service; follows routes/services/repositories layering.
S-1 to S-4 are mapped to components; live read covers S-2 current values, (Inactive) marker covers S-2 AC4/AC5, column-limited join covers S-3 AC2/AC3, untouched SUMMARY_SELECT covers S-4.
Every new field has name, type, nullability and format, matching NOT NULL columns; name fields use placeholder examples and a vague format, and the doctor type override is not spelled out.
Claims check out against product code and A-01/A-02; one unproven statement (only the web app uses the action responses) is stated as fact, and CO-8 is attributed to an unrelated claim.
Trade-offs given for the detail-only join, live values, not reusing DoctorSummary mapping, and action responses changing shape.
Clear, consistent overview, component list and story mapping.

findings.text: Both AppointmentDetail types extend AppointmentSummary and inherit its narrow doctor type; the design says doctor 'becomes' the wider shape but not that the detail type must override doctor while AppointmentSummary stays unchanged.
findings.suggested_fix: State that AppointmentDetail (api and web) redeclares doctor as the extended object, leaving AppointmentSummary.doctor as { id, code, fullName }.

findings.text: The trade-off asserts only the web app consumes the action responses, citing C10; C10 only says the web app uses client.ts, not that no other client calls the API.

cites.quote: only the web app uses them, through `web/src/api/client.ts`, C10
The web app talks to the API only through `web/src/api/client.ts`.

findings.suggested_fix: Reword to say the change is additive and the web app is the only known client, or mark it as an assumption.

findings.text: The name fields give a placeholder example and a descriptive format instead of a concrete example value, so ACs cannot compare against an exact sample.

cites.quote: format: current specialization name, example: "<specialization name>"

findings.suggested_fix: Use a concrete seed value as example (for example a real specialization and department name) and format 'free text, as stored'.

findings.text: Known attributes CO-3, CO-4 and CO-8 to C9, but C9 covers only AppointmentService; the router and api client symbols have no claim of their own.

cites.quote: CO-3, CO-4, CO-8: existing symbols from the module map (C9); no change needed.
`AppointmentService` answers get, book, reschedule, cancel and close with the same appointment detail.

findings.suggested_fix: Point CO-4 and CO-8 to their own module-map citations (or C8/C10) in the Known section.
